quirks.summary: The whole Idox install returned HTTP 503 under a 'Page Not Found' title throughout testing; nothing could be attempted.
quirks.detail: Checked 2026-09-29: /online-applications/, /online-applications/search.do?action=advanced and the host root all 503. The root 302s to /online-applications, which 503s in turn. PlanIt still resolves Lewisham to this same URL with scraper_type Idox, so this reads as an outage rather than a migration -- but it was not reachable at all, so the vendor stays unverified and no recipe step was run.
quirks.workaround: Re-test when the host is back. If it stays down, re-resolve via PlanIt and check for a migration.

verification.note: Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; vendor confirmed by fingerprint (idox-public-access)
Advanced search worked but returned nothing for 1-31 July 2026; not a retrieval failure. Retry with a wider window.
Not reachable: HTTP 503 on every path tried, including the host root. PlanIt still points at the same URL, so recorded as an outage and left untested rather than broken.
